sources.snippet: What is AutoTrain? AutoTrain is an automatic way to train and deploy state-of-the-art Machine Learning models, seamlessly integrated with the Hugging Face ecosystem. What Machine Learning tasks are available for training? Available today: text classification, entity recognition, summarization, question answering, translation, tabular classification and regression, image classification and LLM ...
